description: This bar chart illustrates the distribution of tokens (in thousands) across various content categories, with the horizontal axis labeled "Categories" displaying the category names—Administrative, Religion, Non-fiction, Fiction, Law, News, and Blogs—in left-to-right order. The vertical axis, labeled "Tokens (K)", represents the quantity of tokens in thousands, using a linear scale ranging from 0 to 10,000, with tick marks at intervals of 2,000. Each bar corresponds to a category and is topped with its exact token count in blue text: the "Administrative" category has a bar reaching 6,472 tokens; "Religion" has 652 tokens; "Non-fiction" has 1,889 tokens; "Fiction" has 387 tokens; "Law" has 354 tokens; "News" has the highest value at 10,584 tokens; and "Blogs" has the lowest value at 32 tokens. The "News" bar is visually emphasized with a distinct light blue color and is the tallest bar on the chart, while the "Blogs" bar is the shortest and is shaded gray with a diagonal pattern. The bars are arranged in descending order of token count from left to right, starting with "Administrative" and ending with "Blogs".
